entities.summary: Thammasat Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani, Thailand. It is currently used mostly for football matches. The stadium holds 25,000. It is on Thammasat University's Rangsit campus. It is located close to Bangkok.
